name: Terminal
author: Max54nj
shortDescription: Adds a simple terminal to SkEditor
longDescription:
Adds a very simple terminal to SkEditor. 

The terminal currently does not support colors.

Works best with Powershell and CMD on Windows.
Bash and sh are only partially supported.

Features:
- Terminal Session Restoring
- Custom Terminals
- Open terminal with hotkey (not configurable yet)

Translations:
- English
- German
